name: create_booking
description: Book a confirmed appointment on Smith England Salon's calendar. Only call this after check_availability has confirmed the slot is free AND the caller has explicitly confirmed the service, date, time, name, and email back to you.

Authorization.note: ElevenLabs workspace secret 'smith_england_salon_calcom_auth_header' — never the raw key in this file

username.description: Always hammad-muntazir-9zpmnb (the Cal.com account this deployment writes to).

start.description: ISO 8601 confirmed slot start time — must be a value check_availability returned as free.

name.description: Caller's full name, confirmed back letter-by-letter

notes.description: Any context from the call worth passing to the salon, e.g. caller's phone number

metadata.description: Idempotency guard — conversationId set to this call's ElevenLabs conversation id so a network retry can't double-book.
